caption: The drawing depicts a single large ornamental urn made of what appears to be patinated metal, predominantly greenish-blue in color with brownish spots indicating oxidation or age. The urn has a wide, flared rim with a decorative scrolling pattern and a vertically grooved interior edge. The body of the urn is rounded and decorated with a repeating pattern of oval and shell-like motifs. The vessel is supported by a fluted, vase-shaped neck and sits atop a two-tiered square base adorned with additional scrollwork at its upper section. The background of the drawing is a plain, light neutral color without any additional objects or details. At the bottom left of the drawing, the name "John H. Teracuzzi" is written in small capital letters.
title: Garden Urn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
